facts.fact: 辛西娅在回程马车上意识到自己真正的心意。
facts.anchor: A veil had been removed from her eyes.

facts.fact: 海伦娜说别人念头喧闹，唯独辛西娅这里是安静的。
狐狸哈姆雷特在心里问两人为什么身上有彼此的气味。
facts.anchor: Like why you two smell of each other.

facts.fact: 辛西娅承认拍照时想的是海伦娜的头发和想尝她的冲动。
facts.anchor: ‘I was thinking that your hair is like a blazing sunset. Or the glory of autumn. And I wanted to taste you.’

facts.fact: 海伦娜说出自己九、十岁时在亚麻橱里初次心动的女孩名字。
辛西娅的母亲说她希望魔法绕过女儿，像绕过自己和外祖母一样。
facts.anchor: ‘I hoped it would pass you by. As it did me, and my mother. You are destined to be a grand lady of the beau monde, my darling. Magic has no place in this world. Come.’

facts.fact: 海伦娜说辛克莱心里闪过的名字是乔治·利珀特。
facts.anchor: ‘Not intentionally. But when you asked who killed your husband, he thought it clear as church bells on Sunday. George Lippert.’

facts.fact: 海伦娜说只能听见人的念头，听不见动物的。
